text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear stance stated in the opening and repeated in the conclusion","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay makes its position on driverless cars explicit and keeps that claim visible throughout."},{"evidence":"paragraphs weighing safety, cost, and convenience","quality":"argument development","description":"The essay develops its case with multiple reasons that are each elaborated rather than merely named."},{"evidence":"“if the technology fails…who is at fault-the driver or the manufacturer?” and later discussion of safety features","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"The essay brings in article details to support its claims instead of relying mainly on general statements."},{"evidence":"links problems to possible responses such as manual takeover and vibrating seats","quality":"reasoning and qualification","description":"The essay shows how the technology could work around objections and acknowledges limits without losing its overall argument."},{"evidence":"“All in all…should be developed” with a full wrap-up of earlier points","quality":"conclusion coherence","description":"The ending restates the position and ties together the main reasons in a coherent final judgment."}]}
